briefConventions: This repo is PUBLIC and open-sourceable — never commit engagement specifics, client names, real figures from a live plan, or anything identifying a subject. Worked examples in the skills must be generic. State (vaults, outputs) lives OUTSIDE the skill, under ~/Documents/business/<slug>/; the repo holds method and tools only, never user data. Scripts are Node with ZERO dependencies (import only from node:*) — no package.json, no install step, because people clone this to get the skills and must not need a package manager. Prose style: section headings are action titles stating the finding, not labels; banned words are revolutionary, disruptive, game-changing, cutting-edge, delve, tapestry, paramount, seamless-as-filler, landscape-as-filler. Every rule added to a skill must name the failure it prevents — a rule with no failure mode behind it is ceremony and gets cut. Run 'node scripts/check.mjs' green before opening a PR. Never rebase, never self-merge. Merge commits, not squash.
